name: A Claude Code session records each agent assignment as a Work item, with outcome and cost
asks: I'd love to see you the ringleader use-and-improve our agentic technologies for helping you ringlead, and your agents work more efficiently with less token cost, more tracked costs, etc.
status: open: the Work board is not reachable from a Claude Code session on Bare Cedar Fog today

what-a-session-can-call-today: the cost ledger and the per-Work roll-up (computer-inference-system-services-section, inference-expense-ledger-services-section scripts): local files, no node needed
the agent assignment journal (record-agent-assignment.mjs): assigned and outcome events keyed by Work id, session and agent, so cost attaches to Work now
missing: no MetroPlat or FeltOS node process is running on the host: work-board, work-open and work-move (feltos src/work/work-board.mjs, generated work-arena descriptors) have nothing to answer them

the project .mcp.json declares no mcpServers, so a Claude Code session has no tool named work-open or work-move; metroplat exposes them through its MCP surface (src/mcp-surface.mjs) and the agent-hook operation (harness=mcp)

work-board moves refuse an anonymous invocation (feltos src/server/work-arena-operations.mjs): the session needs an authenticated subject recognised as holding an office, and none is provisioned for the lead

the session's hooks do not reach a node: only the PreToolUse host-resource hook is installed, so SubagentStop and SessionEnd never admit token-usage rows through metroplat's agent-hook operation (which also skips transcripts over 128 MiB)
no bridge replays assignment journal events as work-open (a report or aim) and work-move (outcome) once a node is reachable
measured.to-build: A node endpoint the lead can reach (MetroPlat on Bare Cedar Fog with its MCP surface declared in the project .mcp.json), an office allocation and authenticated subject for the lead, and a replay command that reads the assignment journal and plays work-open for each new Work id and work-move for each outcome, attaching the per-Work cost roll-up as evidence.

x-provenance.basis: Read of agent-harness carrier/session.mjs and hooks/service.mjs, feltos work/work-board.mjs and server/work-arena-operations.mjs, the host's listening processes, the user hook keys and the project .mcp.json.
